## Changed
- **The mod list no longer flickers while it updates.** The list is now drawn off-screen first, updates that arrive close together are combined into one, rows are updated in place instead of the whole list being cleared and refilled, and the spinner only redraws its own row.

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.5-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. To update, exit the running app from the tray menu and replace the old `CS2ModVerifier.exe` with the new one. Your settings and ignored findings are kept.

**Windows SmartScreen will most likely warn you**, because the exe is not code-signed. Check the download first, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`, or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
